title: ICT Ai Agent Fully Autonomous With Results
author: Careful_Task_1858
selftext:
Hey everyone! 🚀

After months of development, I’ve officially finished building my **fully autonomous ICT AI trading agent!**

We've gone from backtesting to demo trading, and the results have been promising. The agent independently analyzes market structure, identifies trading opportunities, and executes trades using ICT concepts.

**This week, we're taking the next big step: LIVE trading with real capital!** 📈

Follow the journey and see the AI in action. I'll be sharing trades, performance updates, and how the system makes its decisions.

👉 [https://x.com/ictAiAgent](https://x.com/ictAiAgent)

\#ICT #TradingAI #AlgoTrading #Forex #AutomatedTrading

comments.author: leroylabs
comments.body: The move from demo to live capital is where I’d want to see the execution assumptions made falsifiable. For each ICT setup, publish the market-structure state the agent saw, decision timestamp, quoted spread, requested order, actual fill, and any intervention or rejected order. Comparing those live records with the same week replayed through the demo engine would show whether the “promising” results survive slippage and broker behavior, and whether fully autonomous really means no discretionary filtering.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: how many demo trades did it take before you were happy going live? ICT setups cluster around the same few session times, so a few weeks of demo can be a pretty small sample.
